subject: Banking
title: Deposit Insurance: Savior and Enabler
description: Learn Deposit Insurance: Savior and Enabler in one minute.

hook.text: FDIC insurance ended bank runs but created moral hazard. Depositors stopped checking if their bank was safe.

buildup.text: Before FDIC, depositors closely watched their bank's health. Insurance removed the incentive to monitor bank behavior.

discovery.text: Banks take bigger risks because insured depositors don't flee. Only uninsured depositors create market discipline.

twist.text: SVB proved the limits. 96% uninsured deposits created massive run risk that insurance wasn't designed to cover.

climax.text: Deposit insurance is essential but imperfect. It prevents panic at the cost of reducing accountability.

punchline.text: Stops bank runs. But removes the incentive for depositors to watch their bank.

quiz.question: What is the downside of deposit insurance?
options: It reduces depositors' incentive to monitor bank health
